actual.titulo: The Murder Tapes • One in the Chamber
actual.descripcion: One in the Chamber | A retirement community in Evansville, Ind., reels when police find Odie Carrier Jr. mortally shot in his own home; puzzled even more by the surprising way he died, police must work quickly if they are going to find the person responsible.

siguiente.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Help, I've Been Shot
siguiente.descripcion: Help, I've Been Shot | Officers with the Evansville police department arrive at a crime scene to find a shooting victim barely alive and needing medical attention; the stakes get higher after they realize there might be another injured victim who's now missing.

lista.descripcion: Friends Like These | A woman shocks the Titus County Sheriff's Office when she reports the kidnapping of her husband, Ernie; police race to find him, but things are not as they seem, and they must first figure out who is telling the truth to them to solve the case.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: American Detective • The Barrel
lista.descripcion: The Barrel | In the Miami suburbs, a hard-working mother from Trinidad vanishes into thin air; detectives Danny Smith and Jonathan Zeller soon uncover her secrets but then are stalled until they come up with a highly unusual way to smoke out the perpetrator.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: American Detective • Six Pounds of Pressure
lista.descripcion: Six Pounds of Pressure | A mother raises the alarm when her daughter goes missing from the Colorado house she had recently moved into; while Det. Ben Endreson is investigating, an unusual suspect comes forward to confess her involvement, but her story doesn't quite add up.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: American Detective • Crimson Snow
lista.descripcion: Crimson Snow | Police find an accomplished U.S. Forest Service worker executed beneath a mound of snow in Northern California; a missing wallet and a pair of jumper cables send Investigator Greg Hagwood on a multi-state manhunt for the killer.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: American Detective • Mr. Innocent
lista.descripcion: Mr. Innocent | In Minnesota, firemen put out a house fire and find a woman's body inside; Agent Rob Frank learns that the victim was babysitting a friend's daughter, who is now missing; it is a race against time to track down the killer with a horrifying motive.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: American Detective • It Begins With One
lista.descripcion: It Begins With One | When a young woman turns up dead in south Texas, Captain Federico Calderon fears the killer has disappeared into Mexico; as more bodies turn up, investigators pick up on the trail of a serial killer, leading to a showdown in the streets of Laredo.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda • Blood Relative
lista.descripcion: Blood Relative | Una serie de investigación de no ficción de casos de asesinato contados a través de la experiencia personal del detective retirado, el teniente Joe Kenda. A través de recreaciones, discusiones con equipos de investigación y entrevistas con las familias de las víctimas y otras personas involucradas, el programa destaca los éxitos de Kenda con su historial de 400 casos de homicidio y una tasa de solución del 92 por ciento.

lista.titulo: A Body in the Basement • Living Through Hell
lista.descripcion: Estreno ║ Living Through Hell | Nino Puglisi's shooting death leaves his wife, Debbie, missing; initially seen as domestic violence, a puddle of blood in the basement and a terrifying 911 call reveal the horrifying details behind Nino's murder and what exactly happened to Debbie.

lista.titulo: A Body in the Basement • She Said No
lista.descripcion: Estreno ║ She Said No | In the dead of winter, a killer murders a young mother next to her sleeping daughters, shocking a quiet Pennsylvania community; but investigators confronting mysterious clues at the scene soon learn that the killer is several steps ahead of them.

lista.titulo: A Body in the Basement • Follow the Money
lista.descripcion: Follow the Money | In 2021, in a Norman, Oklahoma basement, police unwrap the gruesome contents of a suspicious box.

lista.descripcion: Cris-Cross | In 2004, Detective Postiglione investigates the rare double homicide of two young college students in an apartment near a Nashville university; when a third victim is gunned down, Postiglione launches a state-wide manhunt to catch a ruthless killer.

lista.titulo: Six Degrees of Murder • The Body in the Rug
lista.descripcion: The Body in the Rug | The nationwide hunt for a serial killer begins after investigators find a body rolled up in a rug in a Minneapolis apartment; later, the suspect shoots and kills fashion designer Gianni Versace on the steps of his mansion in Miami Beach, Fla.

lista.titulo: Six Degrees of Murder • Crime Writer
lista.descripcion: Crime Writer | Journalism major Brook Baker is brutally murdered while researching a controversial article, and the police must sort through hundreds of suspects to find her killer.

lista.titulo: Six Degrees of Murder • Sensing Secrets
lista.descripcion: Sensing Secrets | Young mother Christine Sheddy is on the verge of making a fresh start when she disappears without a trace.

lista.titulo: Six Degrees of Murder • Dear Dad
lista.descripcion: Dear Dad | After handyman Jack Reid is murdered, police have no choice but to look for a killer among his clients and family members, then they uncover a suspect from out of the blue.

lista.titulo: Obsession: Dark Desires • Texts, Lies, and Videotape
lista.descripcion: Texts, Lies, and Videotape | Katie Call's ex, Todd, refuses to accept the collapse of their relationship, and he hides video cameras and microphones in her home, biding his time to wreak a bloody revenge.

lista.titulo: Obsession: Dark Desires • The Olympic Creep
lista.descripcion: The Olympic Creep | When Olympic gold medalist Sheila Taormina agrees to coach an athlete, she doesn't realize he harbors dark fantasies that will turn her life into a living nightmare.
